बृहन्त्, and वृहन्त् वृहन्त् (originally ptcple. pres. of बृह्),
 I. adj., f. हती.
 1. Large, great, Pañc. 175, 9.
 2. Much.
 II. f. अती.
 1. A wrapper, a mantle.
 2. A reservoir, a place containing water.
 3. A large lute.
 4. The name of two plants.
 --Cf. probably Goth. bairgahei; A.S. beorh, beorg.

बृह् + अस्-पति, and बृहस्पति वृहस्पति, m.
 1. A deity, originally The lord of prayer, Daśak. in
. The regent of the planet Jupiter and preceptor of the gods,
. The name of a saint and lawgiver, Pañc. i. d. 111.
बृहत्स्फिच्, i. e. बृहन्त्-, m. a proper name, Pañc. 117, 13.
